acceptance_defined: 2026-11-06 before candidate26 or its tests exist or run
reference_platform: MATLAB R2025a Update 1 / Simulink / Simscape Electrical Specialized Power Systems

cycle_features.source_current_normalization: Derived from actual native iL/UC/duty and the independently resolved native selector/carrier plus midpoint KCL. Solve all PWL-duty/analytic-carrier crossings, integrate each physical mode separately. Native sparse source samples remain measured audit data; never integrate their switching jumps as PWL ramps or label reconstructed gates/current as directly logged.
cycle_features.source_power_direction: 30V times whole-record mean source current must be positive in both; finite losses and change of nonzero L/C energy must balance within declared internal numeric tolerances

known_difference: Reference has continuous PI/1us lag and natural PWM with two antiparallel MOSFET diodes; candidate uses existing discrete LP/PI, external limit and grid-sampled complementary IdealSwitch. Its 50ns timing is frozen, not fitted. Diodes may be omitted only within the independently checked inactivity domain and native-refinement evidence; no automatic diode or general device equivalence claimed. UC/iL are continuous across explicit load events; Isrc has switching jumps, so only edge-audited per-carrier-cycle means are acceptance metrics. All samples, including t0 and every root-near Boolean ambiguity, remain in raw artifacts. No fitted shifts, scale, phase or omitted cycles.
